old_evidence.text: The reader now handles the network change and continues the payment flow.

findings: Both captures describe a handheld Stripe Terminal SDK reader for iOS, Android and React Native, using BLE or Android-only USB. Its display and PIN pad facilitate PIN-authenticated payments. Software version combines firmware, config and key identifier with underscores. Both retain the April Cartes Bancaires inserted-card PIN-entry network-switch fix, the PCI identifier mapping and the license prerequisite for accessory design downloads.

May 1, 2026 shows 24 explicit availability codes and 4.01.03.00 in the country-version table and newest changelog row. November 7 shows 37 explicit availability codes, all country-version rows at 4.01.07.00, and five additional changelog entries up through 4.01.08.01 dated October 21. The current source summary's 25-market count overcounts the pinned May list and its unqualified latest version is a May description.

November adds 13 availability codes, nine country-version rows, October initial HK/MX config entries and two new HK/MX key identifier rows. The `4.01.04.00` changelog adds 11 languages. Device availability is distinct from on-reader tipping eligibility.
substantive_changes: Availability banner gains HK, BG, HR, CY, EE, HU, LV, LI, LT, MT, RO, SK and SI. November regional version rows add HK, BGHRRO, CYMT, EELV, CHHULI, LT, SK, SI and MX.

Changelog adds 4.01.04.00 (May 26, 2026, 11 languages), 4.01.05.00 (June 30), 4.01.06.00 (August 3), 4.01.07.00 (September 8) and 4.01.08.01 (October 21), each describing general bug fixes and code improvements. November also adds SZZZ_HK_v1 dated October 12 and SZZZ_MX_v6 dated October 2 to configuration history, plus their respective 491001 and 481001 key rows.

November adds a Changelog grouping and reworks date format, table Markdown, image source, and wording. The iOS URL encoding and removed See also link to Collect payments are presentation/navigation. Preserve setup, integration and connection routes.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve May's 4.01.03.00 regional rows and firmware changelog as dated history. The 4.01.03.00 Cartes Bancaires fix applies to manual network switching during PIN entry with an inserted card.

Preserve PCI identifier examples as published and route to the scoped regional key and configuration tables. The mechanical .STP download requires reviewing and accepting the Terminal Design File License Agreement, with downloading indicating acceptance.
conflicts: The November banner excludes MX, while Mexico appears in the November regional version, initial configuration and key identifier tables. November setup and mobile-reader captures also omit MX from their availability rows. Date and state that distinction without inferring Mexico availability from configuration artifacts.

The November country-version table and firmware changelog top entries name different versions. Keep 4.01.07.00 as the firmware prefix in the country rows and 4.01.08.01 as the newest recorded changelog release. The documentation does not establish country rollout or installed version.

Current source and Terminal hardware concept say 25 markets. The two pinned availability lines contain 24 and 37 codes, respectively. Existing APAC latest-version strings end in 491001 even though the key table lists 490001 as the initial identifier for AUMYNZSG and lists 491001 for HK in November. The November regional version table also overlaps DE and CH between old and new rows, and the CZ suffix is printed 51001. Preserve exact rows and source labels instead of choosing a mapping or repairing IDs.
unresolved_questions: Why November lists Mexico firmware and configuration while omitting it from the availability banner, whether November's 4.01.08.01 had reached any country row, which DE or CH configuration is selected, and how APAC/CZ key strings relate to the separate identifier rows are not established by the captures.

findings: Add the dated November reader and firmware evidence. Correct the May count of displayed country codes. Keep country availability, regional firmware rows, changelog and key history separately scoped, with links to both raw captures and reciprocal stripe-terminal route.
conflicts: Preserve Mexico's configuration-versus-banner split, the firmware table-versus-changelog split, and exact overlapping regional and key rows.
source_assessments.reason: The source is a firmware and market selection reference, and the November capture documents substantial availability, configuration and release changes. The May-only 25-market statement is also inaccurate against its pinned raw line.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/readers/bbpos-wisepad3, source-stripe-terminal-bbpos-wisepad3 describes a handheld reader with a display and PIN pad. The integrator connects it from an iOS, Android or React Native Stripe Terminal SDK mobile app using BLE, with USB limited to Android. The reader software version joins firmware version, configuration name and key identifier. The November 7, 2026 capture lists regional software versions with firmware prefix 4.01.07.00 while listing 4.01.08.01 on October 21 as the newest changelog row. Its availability banner has 37 codes. In May 1, 2026 the banner listed 24 and both firmware views listed 4.01.03.00. The current summary correctly preserves device, SDK and version structure but calls the May banner 25 countries and 4.01.03.00 the unqualified latest firmware. See old raw lines 7-11, old raw lines 15-31, old raw lines 33-42, new raw lines 8-12, new raw lines 16-41 and new raw lines 45-60. The 4.01.03.00 April 21 changelog entry retained in both says an inserted Cartes Bancaires payment continues after manual network switching during PIN entry. November also adds 11 languages in 4.01.04.00. Under accessories, the developer reviews and accepts the license before downloading the .STP files. See old raw line 42, old raw lines 152-156, new raw lines 57-60 and new raw lines 174-178. The reference records documented release/configuration transitions and one payment-flow fix, without proving installed firmware or account availability.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/readers/bbpos-wisepad3, update source-stripe-terminal-bbpos-wisepad3 with dated May 1 and November 7, 2026 raw links. November adds HK, BG, HR, CY, EE, HU, LV, LI, LT, MT, RO, SK and SI to the availability banner, expands regional rows including Mexico, adds five changelog releases with 11 languages in 4.01.04.00, and adds Hong Kong and Mexico initial configuration entries and key rows. See old raw lines 7-11, old raw lines 20-31, old raw lines 39-42, old raw lines 103-116, old raw lines 138-150, new raw lines 8-12, new raw lines 21-41, new raw lines 51-60, new raw line 134 and new raw lines 157-172. Preserve the 4.01.07.00 regional table versus 4.01.08.01 changelog distinction. MX appears in the regional version, configuration and key tables while its availability is unresolved because the banner omits it. The regional rows overlap DE/CH and the APAC version suffix differs from the initial APAC key table entry. Preserve exact documented labels and avoid inferring assignments. Keep the reciprocal stripe-terminal route and cross-links to the WisePad 3 setup and mobile-reader overview. The setup/overview listings agree with the November banner, while country lists for features such as on-reader tipping belong to their own guides. Changelog regrouping, date and table formatting and image references are presentation. The Collect payments link disappears from See also while setup, integration and connection links remain. That is navigation evidence. See old raw lines 158-165 and new raw lines 180-186.
